mina: Quick flag from onboarding run for orion-lite q8: mixed CJK + Arabic shortctx samples sometimes reverse segments at detok.

Sample: Input: "第3章 5. اختبار"
orion-lite (q8) detok -> "اختبار 5. 第3章"
fp32/q5 are fine.

rohan: I dumped token ids: q5 -> [402, 99, 17, 8001, 202]; q8 -> [402, 99, 17, 8001, 8002, 202]. 8002 maps to U+202A/U+202B-like control in vocab.

li: saw a tokenizer-maps deploy at 1709876500 yesterday. Could be remap. Also note q8 seems to emit that extra id in low-prob boundary cases.

mina: mitigation idea: detok postfilter that drops isolated bidi-controls when between CJK and RTL. We'll log occurrences.

devops-bot: queued jobs: vocab-diff, emission-check (fp32/q5/q8), detok-smoke.

rohan: filing ML-1999 with examples + token dumps. Holding q8 canary for orion-lite until we confirm.

li: I'll run vocab sha diffs and a small emission sweep. ETA ~45m. Ping when done. :thumbsup:
